posts.title: Senegal’s President Opens Dakar Art Biennale
posts.description: President Bassirou Diomaye Faye opened the 16th Dak'Art in Dakar on 19 November, backing a common African art market. 54 artists show until 19 December. The post Senegal’s President Opens Dakar Art Biennale appeared first on The Rio Times .

posts.title: Spain Poll Gives Conservatives 194 Seats
posts.description: The Socialists have gained 7 seats since early November, but GAD3's poll for ABC still gives the conservative People's Party and Vox 194 of 350 seats. The post Spain Poll Gives Conservatives 194 Seats appeared first on The Rio Times .

posts.title: Mexico Seizes Cartel Boss as Pressure Mounts
posts.description: Mexico's army says it arrested FBI-wanted cartel boss Chapo Isidro in Sinaloa, while migrant caravans and an election dispute press Sheinbaum. The post Mexico Seizes Cartel Boss as Pressure Mounts appeared first on The Rio Times .
